title: Push Pull Duel
description: Three antagonist supersets: wide push-ups, pike push-ups and chair dips against back pulls

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching your back, breathe

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulder-width, focus on the chest

exercises.name: Reverse snow angels
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms by your sides, sweep them in an arc on the floor

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower your head between your hands

exercises.name: Prone T raises
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms in a T position, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows pointing back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Floor face pulls
exercises.instructions: Face down, elbows at 90 degrees, pull back

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate your body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind your head, pull the elbow with your other hand

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring your foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
